premises.text: Logistics costs in Africa are significantly higher than in the United States due to a broken system.
premises.evidence_span: If the costs were at parity with the United States, you'd be paying up to one-third of the price that you're paying for many of your core commodities, cement, fertilizer, grains, it's massive. The logistics system is broken.

premises.text: Truckers are idle 93% of the time due to lack of centralized coordination.
premises.evidence_span: the truckers are empty or idle 93% of the time. Why? Again, because there's no centralized coordination or flexibility in the current system.

premises.text: Delays in logistics can cause trucks to idle for days.
premises.evidence_span: we're often seeing in the system that trucks are waiting for three days on the loading, for a journey that takes 12 hours, and then three days on the offloading.

premises.text: Lori provides a tech-enabled logistics optimization solution that offers flexibility and centralized coordination.
premises.evidence_span: Lori is powering African logistics. We are a tech-enabled logistics optimization solution that provides this flexibility and centralized coordination.

premises.text: Data-driven decision-making can improve logistics operations.
premises.evidence_span: by collecting thousands of data points of every single truck and every journey, and then providing data-driven decision-making through our systems.

premises.text: Lori's platform provides real-time visibility and tracking for cargo owners.
premises.evidence_span: we provide our cargo owners with further visibility through dashboards and tracking mechanisms where you can see where your trucks are at any given stage live.
